title: export.rs: build_export_car uses ORDER BY ingested_at_ms DESC but sets first found block as root — root is newest, not most useful
description: export.rs: articles are selected newest-first (ORDER BY ingested_at_ms DESC) and the first block found in IPFS becomes the single CAR root. The comment says 'The most-recent article CID whose block is found becomes the single root.' For a CAR file intended as an archive slice, using the newest article as the root is counterintuitive — CAR roots normally represent the entry point into a DAG, which for a flat list is typically the oldest (first) or an aggregate manifest, not the newest. This choice is undocumented in any design decision. Not a correctness bug but may surprise importers that use the root to determine download order.
